title: synthetic-sciences/openscience
claim: synthetic-sciences/openscience — The open-source AI workbench for scientific research
why_good: An open AI workbench built for real scientific workflows — AI-for-science is a large, underserved, high-value vertical where general chat tools fit poorly.
value: Sell to labs / biotech / R&D as seats + compute + validated pipelines; science budgets are large and sticky once one workflow lands.
risk: 'Workbench' is broad — it needs one killer, validated workflow to land; academic stars ≠ willingness to pay; parts overlap incumbents like Benchling.

zh.claim: synthetic-sciences/openscience —— 面向科研的开源 AI 工作台。
zh.why_good: 为真实科研工作流打造的开源 AI 工作台——AI-for-science 是个大而未被满足、高价值的垂直,通用聊天工具在这里很不合适。
zh.value: 卖给实验室 / 生物科技 / 研发部门:席位 + 算力 + 经过验证的流水线;科研预算大,且某个工作流一旦落地就很黏。
zh.risk: 「工作台」太宽泛——它需要一个杀手级、经过验证的工作流才能立住;学术星标 ≠ 付费意愿;部分与 Benchling 这类现有玩家重叠。
zh.hook: 身边没有工程师的科研人员,想要一个能读文献、跑实验、写稿子的智能体——已经有几百人在自己部署并认真报 bug。
zh.does: 开源科研 AI 工作台:给它一个目标,它读文献、写并运行代码、跑实验、起草论文。npm 可装;约四周 2.9k★/404 fork。
zh.gap: 科研人员正是「拿着极客工具的非极客」——npm 安装、本地模型配置、settings 文件。而中文侧(中文文献、国产模型、内网部署)完全空白。
zh.counter: 公司项目、迭代很快;FutureHouse、Elicit 和各家「深度研究」都盯着同一批用户。个人做通用版就是和融资团队正面硬刚。
zh.differentiator: 不抄通用版,做本土化:中文文献+内网/私有部署给国内课题组,或只打包一个学科(如生信流水线)。
zh.consumer_angle: 研究生和独立研究者——凡能缩短论文周期的东西,痛到愿意付钱。

hook: Researchers without an engineer on call want an agent that reads the literature, runs the experiments and writes them up — hundreds are already self-hosting it and filing detailed bug reports.
pick_reason: The project addresses a specific need in scientific research with a clear product offering that can be monetized.
does: Open-source AI workbench for science: give it a goal and it reads papers, writes and runs code, executes experiments, drafts the write-up. npm-installable; 2.9k★/404 forks in about four weeks.

voices.quote: I have updated to 1.3.0 version, but I still see it happening… Nothing major however

gap: Scientists are exactly non-geeks holding a geek tool — npm install, local-model config, settings files. And the Chinese research-lab side (中文文献、国产模型、内网部署) is empty.
counter: Company-built and shipping fast; FutureHouse, Elicit and every vendor's 'deep research' aim at the same user. A solo general-purpose copy competes head-on with funded teams.
differentiator: Not a copy — a localization: Chinese literature + intranet/private deployment for domestic labs, or one packaged discipline (e.g. bioinformatics) instead of a general workbench.
consumer_angle: Grad students and independent researchers — pain deep enough to pay for anything that shortens the paper cycle.
